tasks.DefineFunction: Write a function to find all the values in a list that are greater than a specified number and return a boolean indicating if any numbers are greater than the specified number.
tasks.TestFunction: Run tests on the defined function.

answer: The function should return a boolean value indicating whether any numbers in the list are greater than the specified number. The provided test cases indicate that the function should return True if at least one number is greater than the specified number and False otherwise.
